cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
The [Company name masked] Cancer Center is on a mission for providing industry-leading cancer research and care that benefits patients locally and globally. Our ultimate goal is to eradicate cancer and we are proudly making progress every day. When we say patient care is a priority, we mean it. We assemble custom teams of field experts to address each individual's unique needs.
The research and innovations developed at the [Company name masked] Cancer Center ultimately influence the global network of cancer care. Our team fights for far more than just [Location masked] patients. The learnings achieved through the care of local patients has wide-reaching implications for creating tomorrow's standard of cancer care. Through facilitating first-in-the-nation trials and growing a depth of understanding only available through a multidisciplinary approach, the [Company name masked] Cancer Center team is equipped to deliver treatment advancements that will be applied in facilities across the world. The team offers a proving ground that paves the way for patients in other areas to have access to new options.
We are currently seeking talented and motivated individuals to join CAR-T core at the [Company name masked] Cancer Center. The successful candidate should possess hands-on experience in oncology, cell biology and immunology, in particular TCR-T/CAR-T cell biology. The candidate will be able to contribute to the effort for developing T cell therapy platform, building and optimizing cell-based immunoassays to characterize and assess TCR-T/CAR-T cell functions. The candidate is expected to work in a collaborative cross-functional team environment, perform experiments, organize and analyze results, communicate effectively and present findings in team meetings.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Include, but are not limited to:
Coordinate lab tasks and operations, including ordering, inventory, and other essential functions.
Operate routine experiments in vitro, such as cell culture, cell count, cell resuscitation and cryopreservation, separation of PBMC, PCR and flow cytometer, etc.
Performing routine vivarium procedures such as weight monitoring, tumor measurements, IP/SC injections, blood draws, etc.
Performing in vivo imaging using IVIS or similar system(s).
Processing of mammalian tissues and biofluids for downstream analysis.
Carefully record the experimental process and data and submit timely reports to supervisor.
Analyze, summarize, and report experimental data and relevant documents to supervisor.
Be able to fulfill other job-related tasks assigned by supervisor.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, cell biology or other natural, life, health care or materials science directly related to the research area to which the position is assigned and experience in a research, basic science or clinical setting particularly clinical trials research.
OR
Associate's degree from an accredited college or university in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, cell biology or other natural, life, health care or materials science directly related to the research area to which the position is assigned and a minimum of three years experience in a research, basic science or clinical setting particularly clinical trials research.
Ability to maintain confidentiality
Ability to use sound judgement and work independently
Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and critical thinking skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office and other computer software/databases
Preferred Requirements
Experienced with animal handling
Hands-on experience working with human primary T cells and CAR T cells

Include, but are not limited to:
Coordinate lab tasks and operations, including ordering, inventory, and other essential functions.
Operate routine experiments in vitro, such as cell culture, cell count, cell resuscitation and cryopreservation, separation of PBMC, PCR and flow cytometer, etc.
Performing routine vivarium procedures such as weight monitoring, tumor measurements, IP/SC injections, blood draws, etc.
Performing in vivo imaging using IVIS or similar system(s).
Processing of mammalian tissues and biofluids for downstream analysis.
Carefully record the experimental process and data and submit timely reports to supervisor.
Analyze, summarize, and report experimental data and relevant documents to supervisor.

Ability to maintain confidentiality.
Ability to use sound judgement and work with reasonable independence.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, and to work well with others.
Attention to detail and willingness to develop organizational and critical thinking skills.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office and other computer software/databases.

You will contribute to developing a T cell therapy platform, building and optimizing cell-based immunoassays to characterize and assess TCR-T/CAR-T cell functions. Experience with TCR-T/CAR-T cells is preferred. You will work closely with a cross-functional team, regularly sharing experimental results and presenting findings in team meetings.
cond_0501.responsibilities:
Include, but are not limited to:
Coordinate lab tasks and operations, including ordering, inventory, and other essential functions, staying in regular contact with team members to keep things running smoothly.
Operate routine experiments in vitro, such as cell culture, cell count, cell resuscitation and cryopreservation, separation of PBMC, PCR and flow cytometer, etc.
Performing routine vivarium procedures such as weight monitoring, tumor measurements, IP/SC injections, blood draws, etc.
Performing in vivo imaging using IVIS or similar system(s).
Processing of mammalian tissues and biofluids for downstream analysis.
Carefully record the experimental process and data and actively communicate timely reports to supervisor.
Analyze, summarize, and present experimental data and relevant documents to supervisor, walking them through findings and clarifying results as needed.
Fulfill other job-related tasks assigned by supervisor.
cond_0501.requirements:
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, cell biology or other natural, life, health care or materials science directly related to the research area to which the position is assigned and experience in a research, basic science or clinical setting particularly clinical trials research.
OR
Associate's degree from an accredited college or university in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, cell biology or other natural, life, health care or materials science directly related to the research area to which the position is assigned and a minimum of three years experience in a research, basic science or clinical setting particularly clinical trials research.
Experienced with animal handling is preferred.
Hands-on experience working with human primary T cells and CAR T cells is preferred.
Ability to maintain confidentiality
Ability to use sound judgement and work independently
Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and critical thinking skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office and other computer software/databases
cond_0501.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, in cases where candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given to women applicants in support of our gender balance commitment.
